name: Beverly Center
description:
Beverly Center stands as a sophisticated shopping destination spanning 883,000 square feet in the prestigious Beverly Hills market. Strategically located at the intersection of Beverly Hills, West Hollywood, and Los Angeles, this eight-floor retail tower has become synonymous with luxury shopping and premium retail experiences since its opening in 1982.

The property underwent a transformative $500 million renovation in 2018, emerging with a completely reimagined retail environment that emphasizes luxury brands, contemporary design, and sophisticated aesthetics. The modernized Beverly Center now features an impressive collection of high-end retailers, boutique brands, and exclusive flagship stores housed in an architecturally distinctive eight-story structure that commands attention in the Los Angeles retail landscape.

Beverly Center's tenant mix emphasizes luxury and contemporary brands that appeal to affluent shoppers with sophisticated tastes. The property attracts a clientele that includes entertainment industry professionals, celebrities, and international travelers seeking premier shopping experiences in an exclusive setting. The mall's location at the intersection of three prestigious communities—Beverly Hills, West Hollywood, and Los Angeles proper—provides access to one of the most affluent consumer bases in North America.

The property's architectural design—with its distinctive exterior and multi-level layout—creates a shopping environment that feels exclusive and refined. The renovation incorporated modern retail design principles while maintaining the property's distinctive character and upscale positioning. Premium amenities and finishes throughout the property reflect Beverly Center's commitment to delivering a luxury shopping experience that rivals exclusive shopping destinations in major world cities.

Beyond retail, Beverly Center offers dining options and entertainment venues that complement the shopping experience. The mall's strategic location near Hollywood's cultural attractions, fine dining establishments, and entertainment venues positions it as a comprehensive shopping and entertainment destination for affluent consumers throughout the greater Los Angeles area.
